compatibility: SemVer. Optional additive fields are minor only for tolerant consumers. Removal, rename, narrowing, semantic, or invariant change is major. Every invariant change requires Architecture review.

contracts.name: Shared primitives and command/query envelopes

contracts.versioning: Primitive meaning or envelope identity changes are major.

contracts.name: Errors and lifecycle operation results
contracts.producer: Contract Steward owns taxonomy; Reservation Core adapters produce results
contracts.versioning: New codes minor only with fallback; meaning/removal major.

contracts.name: Availability and atomic allocation
contracts.versioning: Interval, buffer, expansion, or atomicity changes are major.

contracts.name: Reservation preparation, confirmation token, and confirm

success commits reservation, allocation, terms, idempotency result and outbox atomically
contracts.versioning: Token claim/validation semantics major; compatible cryptographic implementation changes allowed.

contracts.name: Reservation lifecycle, expected version, modify, and cancel
contracts.versioning: State, transition, or version semantics major.

contracts.name: Immutable policy versions and accepted terms
contracts.producer: Policy administration publishes; Reservation Core captures acceptance
invariants: booking/cancellation required; others only when applicable
contracts.versioning: Optional evidence minor; applicability/historical meaning major.

contracts.name: Dining intent and deterministic typed tools

contracts.name: Intelligence modes and capability state

contracts.name: Retrieval, citation, and provenance
contracts.versioning: Isolation, temporal, ACL, or provenance semantics major.

contracts.name: Replan proposal, validation, approval, and atomic apply

contracts.name: Audit, transactional outbox, and command-attempt ledger
